resources.string: Search contacts by name or number…
ContactSync needs permission to access system contacts via ContactsContract ContentProvider.
Try adjusting your search query or add contacts on your device.

A Content Provider manages access to a central repository of data. It encapsulates data and provides mechanisms for defining data security. Content Providers are the standard interface that connects data in one process with code running in another process.
A Content URI identifies data in a provider. For Contacts, the URI is:\nContactsContract.CommonDataKinds.Phone.CONTENT_URI\n(content://com.android.contacts/data/phones)
A Cursor provides random read-write access to the result set returned by a database query. We iterate through the Cursor using cursor.moveToNext() to read columns like DISPLAY_NAME and NUMBER.
Android requires explicit user approval before an app reads sensitive personal data like Contacts. ContactSync requests READ_CONTACTS at runtime safely.
